verdict.gold_reason: Article 40(1)(h) of Directive 2019/944 assigns to each TSO the task of collecting congestion rents and payments under the inter-TSO compensation mechanism, which matches the reference answer exactly.

other_articles.why: It covers the inter-TSO compensation for hosting cross-border flows, which TSOs receive and pay. It does not mention congestion rent collection.
It covers congestion income and how TSOs use it, but not the compensation for hosting flows.

verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question is a paraphrase and could point to Regulation 2019/943 Article 49 or Article 19. Only Directive Article 40(1)(h) joins both tasks in one provision.
